description: This file defines the InvoiceDownloadManager class responsible for handling invoice PDF generation, preview, and download functionalities within a web application. It manages invoice data, creates PDF blobs, converts PDFs to images, and handles resource cleanup and error handling.

classes.name: InvoiceDownloadManager
classes.description: A class that manages invoice PDF creation, preview, and download operations, including resource cleanup and error handling.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes invoice data and generates a PDF blob based on provided invoice schema.

methods.name: previewPdf
methods.description: Previews the invoice PDF in a new browser tab.

methods.name: downloadPng
methods.description: Converts the invoice PDF to a PNG image and triggers download.

methods.name: downloadPdf
methods.description: Downloads the invoice as a PDF file.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Resets internal properties and releases resources.

methods.name: isBlobInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the PDF blob is initialized; throws error if not.

methods.name: isInvoiceDataInitialized
methods.description: Checks if invoice data is initialized; throws error if not.

methods.name: isInvoiceNameInitialized
methods.description: Checks if invoice name is initialized; throws error if not.
